captions.detailed: An open steel-frame carillon bell tower featuring a tall, gray lattice steel structure with cross-bracing. Suspended inside the frame are three bronze-colored bells of graduated sizes, each hung from an individual dark gray horizontal yoke. Each yoke is mounted on a revolute axle attached to the frame's cross-beams, allowing the bells to swing back and forth, while a separate clapper is suspended inside each bell via a secondary revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an open steel-frame carillon bell tower with a lattice structure. Inside the tower, suspend three bronze-colored bells of graduated sizes, each mounted on its own horizontal yoke with a revolute joint to swing back and forth, and include an internal clapper for each bell attached via a secondary revolute pin.
captions.factory: Construct the tower framework using a series of box and cylinder primitives to form the vertical posts, horizontal beams, and cross-bracing. Model the yokes using rectangular bars, and the bells by lofting or revolving profiles to create the characteristic flared bell shape. Create the clappers using spheres attached to thin cylinders. Assemble the components using revolute joints to link the yokes to the cross-beams, and secondary revolute joints to connect the clappers inside the bells.
